title: Eventual Inclusion Monotonicity of Expected Random Hull Volume
description: Working paper answering the dimension-only threshold question of Meckes and Reitzner as recorded by Rademacher and restated by Beermann–Reitzner. For each fixed dimension d, once the number of uniform samples exceeds an explicit dimension-only threshold, expected unnormalized convex-hull volume increases under every proper inclusion of convex bodies. The amount of increase is bounded below by a positive dimension-only constant times the body's volume increment. AI-assisted and internally reviewed, not externally peer reviewed.
